:::{#exm-qf-entry-bound}
#### Checking the bound

Let $\matr{E} = \sbmat{ 0.1 & -0.2 \\ -0.2 & 0.1 }$, so $m = 0.2$ works,
and $\vecf{h} = \tp{(1, 1)}$, so $\norm{\vecf{h}}^2 = 2$.
Then

$$
\begin{aligned}
\tp{\vecf{h}} \matr{E} \vecf{h} &= 0.1 - 0.2 - 0.2 + 0.1 \\
&= -0.2,
\end{aligned}
$$

and

$$
\begin{aligned}
\abs{-0.2} &= 0.2 \\
&\le 2 \cdot 0.2 \cdot 2 \\
&= 0.8.
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
